summary: Southern Cross Acquisition II Corp., a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company, filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026 announcing that holders of its 7,652,630 IPO units may elect to separately trade the ordinary shares, warrants and rights underlying those units beginning on or about October 8, 2026. Separated securities will trade on Nasdaq under SCAT, SCATW and SCATR; unseparated units remain as SCATU. No business combination, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. The mechanics are standard unit-separation; what to watch is whether separation precedes an announced de-SPAC transaction and any redemption or trust dynamics.
